verdict.rationale: The API docs say results are returned as JSON containing the transcript and detected languages, so output is structured rather than a plain text blob. Nothing in the pack shows segment or utterance arrays or confidence values. One community user asks whether per-word confidence is possible, which suggests it is not readily available, but a question is not concrete contradiction. Missing for 10: documented segment/utterance structure, confidence scores (per-segment or per-word), and independent hands-on corroboration of the JSON schema.

support.subject: As a developer, results come back as structured JSON with utterances or segments and confidence values, not just a text blob

citations.quote: The model returns the transcript and the detected languages as JSON
